title: Privacy Policy
introduction: Dzvin.co ("we", "our", or "us") operates the Dzvin platform and related services (the "Service"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our Service. By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We may collect the following types of information:

accountInfo.title: Account Information
accountInfo.content: When you create an account, we may collect:
items: authentication information (OAuth providers such as Google or others)

usageData.title: Usage Data
usageData.content: We may collect technical data automatically when you use the Service, including:

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content: We may use cookies and similar technologies to:
cookies.disableNote: You may disable cookies in your browser settings.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
legalBasis.content: If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), we process personal data under the following legal bases:

bases.name: Contractual necessity
bases.description: to provide the Service you requested

bases.name: Legitimate interests
bases.description: to improve and secure the Service

bases.name: Consent
bases.description: where you have provided consent (for example cookies)

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Storage and Security
dataSecurity.content: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
dataSecurity.disclaimer: However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.

thirdPartyServices.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.content: We may use the following trusted third-party services to operate the platform:

services.name: Google / Google Analytics
services.description: collects anonymous usage data to help us improve the Service.

services.name: PostHog
services.description: product analytics platform to monitor user interactions for performance and feature improvements.

services.name: Stripe
services.description: payment processing service; collects billing information necessary for subscriptions.

services.name: Vercel
services.description: hosting provider; may process IP addresses and logs to deliver the Service.

services.name: OAuth providers (e.g., Google, GitHub)
services.description: used for user authentication; only basic profile info is collected.

thirdPartyServices.cookieNote: Some of these services use cookies or similar tracking technologies. For more information, please see our Cookie Policy.
thirdPartyServices.compliance: These providers may process personal data on our behalf and are required to comply with applicable privacy laws.

dataRetention.title: 6. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain personal data only as long as necessary to:
dataRetention.deletionNote: You may request deletion of your account and associated personal data at any time.

yourRights.title: 7. Your Rights Under GDPR
yourRights.content: If you are located in the European Union, you have the right to:
yourRights.exerciseNote: To exercise these rights, contact us using the information below.

childrenPrivacy.title: 8. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: The Service is not intended for children under the age of 13 (or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction).
childrenPrivacy.disclaimer: We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

changes.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
changes.updateNote: When changes occur, we will update the "Last updated" date.
